text:
alex: heads-up — Sana's J-1 has a two-year home-residency requirement; counsel suggests a waiver will likely be needed before any US-based employment. can people-ops outline onboarding and benefits impacts?
sana: hi team 60a I'm hoping to start 2026-06-01 onsite but can do remote until cleared. wondering about relocation and visa-cost coverage if there's delay.
rashid: short answer: payroll requires valid US work auth for I-9. benefits/401k enrollment tie to active payroll record. we can do remote-only onboarding for non-billable tasks; relocation payments usually happen after physical start unless we approve an advance.
karen: legal note: waiver processing timelines are unpredictable; typical range 2-6 months. consular stamping could add extra time. if Sana remains outside US, contractor arrangement is possible but has tax/export considerations.
alex: team can accept remote ramp for 8-12 weeks. no prod access until payroll + background check clear. can we allow pair-programming and docs review?
rashid: yes, meetings and read-only access ok. no production credentials. i'll create a "remote-onboard" checklist and DM it.
sana: is there any way to preserve my equity start date if payroll start moves?
rashid: equity and PTO start dates are anchored to payroll hire date by default. we can request comp review for exceptions but not guaranteed.
hr-bot: FYI: benefits eligibility requires active employee ID. Effective date rule: if hire_date > 15th of month, benefits effective first of next month.
karen: next steps:
- Sana: upload DS-2019 + DS-3035 receipt (if available) to secure portal
- Counsel (Karen): confirm waiver intake status and approximate timeline in 5bd
- People-ops (Rashid): draft remote-onboard checklist; confirm relocation advance policy with finance
- Alex: confirm team OK with delayed physical start and limited remote tasks
sana: uploading docs now. thanks everyone for being flexible.
rashid: noted. I'll open an HRIS ticket and set hire_state = "pending_work_auth". expect email with checklist and permissions summary by EOD tomorrow.
